text:
𝗥𝗔𝗛𝗨𝗟 𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗜𝗡 𝗪𝗘𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗚𝗧𝗢𝗡! 🇮🇳🔥

KL Rahul hit a hundred; he and Padikkal (80) added 167 for the 2nd wicket.
India 295/2, trail NZ's 368 by 73 runs.

Will India take the lead today? 👇

#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

𝗥𝗔𝗛𝗨𝗟 𝗞𝗔 𝗪𝗘𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗚𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗧𝗔𝗞! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 KL Rahul ne Wellington Test mein century jad di
👉 Padikkal ke saath 167 runs ki doosre wicket ki partnership, Padikkal 80 par out
👉 India 295/2, NZ ke 368 se abhi 73 runs peeche

Kya India aaj lead le legi? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
